Name: X-Plane
Author: Robert Wellinger

Actions.Name: Command
Actions.Tooltip: Trigger any X-Plane CommandRef by path.

Actions.Name: Command + Display
Actions.Tooltip: Fire an X-Plane CommandRef on press; show a live DataRef as the title (e.g. G1000 softkeys).

Actions.Name: Guarded Command
Actions.Tooltip: Two-stage button: short press fires command A (e.g. open cover), long press (≥500 ms) fires command B with hold / auto-repeat (e.g. engage starter).

Actions.Name: Guarded DataRef
Actions.Tooltip: Two-stage DataRef button: short press toggles DataRef A (e.g. open cover), long press (≥500 ms) toggles DataRef B (e.g. switch behind cover). Image follows guard DataRef state.

Actions.Name: Rotary
Actions.Tooltip: Fire a CommandRef (optional begin/end HOLD on last enum position) and show a live DataRef value as title. For magneto, frequency tuning, FMS knobs, AP setpoints.

Actions.Name: DataRef Display
Actions.Tooltip: Show a live X-Plane DataRef value as the button title.

Actions.Name: Multi DataRef Display
Actions.Tooltip: Show up to 3 live DataRef values stacked on one button (COM A/S, Wind DIR/SPD/TEMP, …).

Actions.Name: Wind Display
Actions.Tooltip: Show wind direction as a rotating arrow plus wind speed (and optional OAT).

Actions.Name: DataRef Write
Actions.Tooltip: Write a fixed value to an X-Plane DataRef on press. Optional hold mode writes a release value on key release (e.g. test/reset buttons).

Actions.Name: DataRef Toggle
Actions.Tooltip: Two-state DataRef button: image follows live value, click toggles via write or command. Hold Mode turns it into a momentary press/release (test/reset buttons).

Actions.Name: Background Tile
Actions.Tooltip: Decorative tile with no action — for visual separators and background fills.

Description: Control X-Plane 12 from your Stream Deck via the native Web API.
